published_checkpoint.committed: Git-committed alongside this entry, not gitignored — a durable Tier-4 artifact (§9.1) and the immutable-after-creation record (artifact_registry a_t4_checkpoint_phase8) of the six confirmed Phase-8 gate results. It does NOT by itself assert a full gate_12 pass — the checkpoint lists only the six upstream gates it confirms (gate_12 reads it, so cannot appear in its own confirmed list); see scope_and_honesty.

inherited_gate_provenance_quad.authorization: The quad is authorized — not merely asserted — by the run's continuation record: .claude/runs/msca-pf-graph-01/run_manifest.json accepted_upstream_gates.gate_09_budget_consistency = {original_run_id: msca-pf-real-01, status: pass, evidence_path: …/phase7_budget_gate/gate_result.json}, written by bootstrap_phase_prerequisites. Every quad field is copied VERBATIM from the durable gate result; no re-stamping. The five Phase-8 gates (10a/10b/10c/10d/11) carry the current run_id msca-pf-graph-01, so they take no quad entry (additive array holds only the one genuinely cross-run gate).
inherited_gate_provenance_quad.why_only_gate_09: gate_09 is the sole gate bootstrapped from the prior msca-pf-real-01 run (phases 1-7 evidence); the Phase-8 gates were evaluated in-run. A degenerate all-current-run checkpoint would omit inherited_gate_provenance entirely and be byte-identical to the pre-CHK-1 output — this run is the genuine cross-run case the quad exists for.

predicate_confirmation.direct: runner.predicates.schema_predicates.checkpoint_published(<path>, repo_root=<repo>) → passed=True, details.inherited_gate_provenance_checked=['gate_09_budget_consistency'], input_fingerprints={gate_09: sha256:4f7577e2…}. The predicate is consistency-only (CHK-1 D4): it re-validates the quad against durable Tier-4 gate evidence (quad-faithfulness + no-hidden-inheritance), fail-closed on any drift; it does NOT recompute input_fingerprint from current inputs (that content-freshness step is ST-1's, kept separate).
predicate_confirmation.via_gate_evaluator: runner.gate_evaluator._call_predicate('checkpoint_published', {path: docs/tier4_orchestration_state/checkpoints/phase8_checkpoint.json}, 'msca-pf-graph-01', repo_root, None) → passed=True. This exercises the exact wiring gate_12 uses to evaluate g11_p06 (PREDICATE_REGISTRY lookup + arg injection + call), with the canonical path arg from gate_rules_library.yaml g11_p06. So 'gate_12's checkpoint_published predicate passes' is confirmed at the wired-predicate level, not only the bare function.

scope_and_honesty: This closes the SPECIFIC blocker that stalled n08f — the checkpoint-publish step — which is exactly where the node failed under the retired skill. It does NOT assert that gate_12 as a whole passed: gate_12 additionally requires final_exports/ presence (g11_p05/p05b), review closure, budget-confirmation, higher-tier-contradiction and Section-13 predicates that depend on a full n08f revision-agent run (a live Claude node body) and are outside DOD-1e's scope. Per §13.8 this is stated, not glossed: DOD-1e delivers the durable checkpoint + a passing checkpoint_published predicate; it does not flip the run's n08f node state to released. The run manifest's stale node_failure_details.n08f_revision (the retired-skill run_id-mismatch error) is pre-CHK-1 runtime state (§9.2, rebuildable) and is intentionally left as the historical record of the pre-fix failure; it is not evidence of a current fault.
constitutional_legitimacy: Publishing the checkpoint via a direct component drive (rather than inside a full DAGScheduler run of n08f) is faithful: checkpoint_publisher is a deterministic, Claude-free §17.5.3 component whose output is a pure lookup + verbatim copy over durable gate results (single non-deterministic field: the published_at stamp, excluded from the replay invariant, mirroring gate_result.evaluated_at). The direct drive produces the byte-identical artifact the node body would. No gate was declared passed without confirming its condition (§10.4): the checkpoint_published predicate was independently evaluated and passed. No fabricated completion (§12.4/§15): the checkpoint asserts only the six gate results that exist and are status:pass on disk, and the quad is authorized by the durable continuation record.
